gloss: to refine; to polish; to make sophisticated

definitions.gloss: to refine; to polish; to make sophisticated; to be refined
definitions.explanation: To improve something by removing crudeness and adding elegance, or to be in a state of refined sophistication. Most commonly encountered as the past participle {洗練|せんれん}された (refined, sophisticated).

examples.japanese: {洗練|せんれん}された⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧だ。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洗練|せんれん}された⟦{話|はな}し{方|かた}→話し方：15767_hanashikata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: She has a sophisticated way of speaking.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{通|つう}じて→通じる：02289_tsuujiru⟧⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{洗練|せんれん}されてきた。
examples.english: The technique has been refined through years of experience.

notes:
{洗練|せんれん}する literally means to "wash and temper" — to remove impurities and polish what remains. In practice, the past participle form {洗練|せんれん}された is far more common than the active verb form, functioning as an adjective meaning "refined" or "sophisticated." It is a positive, admiring word.

USAGE:
- {洗練|せんれん}された + noun: refined/sophisticated + noun (most common pattern)
- ～⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{洗練|せんれん}される: ~ becomes refined (passive/intransitive)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {洗練|せんれん}された⟦デザイン→デザイン：03860_dezain⟧: refined design
- {洗練|せんれん}された⟦{雰囲気|ふんいき}→雰囲気：03604_funiki⟧: sophisticated atmosphere
- {洗練|せんれん}された⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧: refined flavor
- {洗練|せんれん}された⟦{文章|ぶんしょう}→文章：02957_bunshou⟧: polished writing
- {洗練|せんれん}された⟦{趣味|しゅみ}→趣味：00889_shumi⟧: refined taste

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上品|じょうひん}→上品：03081_jouhin⟧な: elegant; refined — describes inherent class and elegance, not the process of refinement
- ⟦{磨|みが}く→磨く：02427_migaku⟧: to polish; to refine — more concrete, includes physical polishing and skill improvement
- ⟦{熟練|じゅくれん}→熟練：09081_jukuren⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧: skilled; expert — focuses on skill mastery through practice rather than aesthetic refinement
